query: 童工/强迫劳动政策 童工/强迫劳动政策 衡量企业在人权底线方面的预防、识别与纠偏机制。 一、内容质量计算（50%） 基于政策是否包含以下四个核心模块（各占 1 分）： 模块 A：明确禁令。书面承诺禁止雇用 16 周岁以下童工（或当地法定年龄）及任何形式的强迫/债役劳动。 模块 B：识别与尽调。具备入职身份审核流程及定期的现场/远程人权尽调机制。 模块 C：申诉渠道。建立受保护的举报机制，允许员工及供应商员工反馈人权问题。 模块 D：纠偏与补救。明确若发现童工，如何确保其重返校园（如经济资助）；若发现强迫劳动，如何退还押金或证件。 • 2分（卓越）：完全覆盖四个核心模块（A：明确禁令；B：识别与尽调；C：有效申诉渠道；D：具体的纠偏与补救程序）。 • 1分（合格）：具备模块 A（禁令），并涵盖 B/C/D 中的任意 1-2 项，有基础的审核流程但缺乏深度的补救与纠偏机制。 • 0分（不合格）：仅有模块 A（口头承诺），或完全无相关政策披露。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：人权管理与尽调机制覆盖 >80% 的自有业务单元及核心供应商。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅覆盖自有员工而忽略了高风险的供应链环节，或未说明覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 童工 最低就业年龄 年龄核验 强迫劳动 强制劳动 债役劳动 现代奴役 扣押身份证件 扣押护照 招聘费 入职押金 限制人身自由 人权尽职调查 童工返校 退还押金 供应商劳工标准 child labour child labor minimum employment age age verification forced labour forced labor bonded labour modern slavery retention of identity documents passport retention recruitment fees employment deposits restriction of movement human rights due diligence child remediation supplier labour standards 是否书面禁止雇佣16周岁以下童工或低于当地法定最低就业年龄的人员，并禁止强迫劳动、债役劳动及现代奴役？ 是否实施年龄/身份核验及定期人权尽职调查？ 是否禁止扣押身份证件或护照、收取招聘费/押金、限制离职或行动自由？ 员工及供应商员工能否通过受保护渠道举报？ 发现童工或强迫劳动后有哪些补救措施？ 政策和尽调覆盖自有运营及哪些供应商？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '童工/强迫劳动政策'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否书面禁止雇佣16周岁以下童工或低于当地法定最低就业年龄的人员，并禁止强迫劳动、债役劳动及现代奴役？ 是否实施年龄/身份核验及定期人权尽职调查？ 是否禁止扣押身份证件或护照、收取招聘费/押金、限制离职或行动自由？ 员工及供应商员工能否通过受保护渠道举报？ 发现童工或强迫劳动后有哪些补救措施？ 政策和尽调覆盖自有运营及哪些供应商？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有一般人权口号；仅有反歧视政策；仅有供应商环境标准；仅有“遵守劳动法”而无具体禁令与机制；区分：本指标关注童工/强迫劳动的禁令、尽调、申诉与专项补救；违规纠正程序更泛，可覆盖多种违规；供应商行为准则需含明确劳工禁令才可映射；争议事件监控关注外部暴露事件而非政策机制。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

The Group strictly abides by the laws and regulations of the PRC government, including the 'Labour Law' and the 'Labour Contract Law'. The ages of all employees satisfy the requirements of local laws. The phenomenon of forced labour does not exist. If any illegal employment of child labour or forced labour is discovered, the Group will immediately terminate the employment contract, identify the cause and pursue responsibility, and impose appropriate penalties on the employee and related person in violation.

results.text: The Group procures raw materials from the market for producing magnesium metal and magnesium alloys. The Group has developed corresponding inspection, assessment and selection procedures for raw materials suppliers. Upon receipt of bids from raw materials suppliers, the Group assesses comprehensively from the aspects of brand, quality, payment, schedule of delivery, reputation, and after-sales service, and seriously considering their energy and environmental policy to maximise environmental protection and minimise pollution. The most appropriate product supplier is determined based on a comprehensive score and ranking assessment by comparing individual suppliers. It ensures that premium-quality raw materials can be sourced at competitive prices, and the values of the selected supplier on environment, community and ethics are embraceable. All of the Group's suppliers are located in mainland China. There are about 10 major suppliers. During the Reporting Period, there were no material instances of non-compliance concerning the supply chain management.

results.section: Energy use/water efficiency targets and management / A2: Use of Resources
results.text: The water consumption within the plants is mainly due to the water replenishment of the recirculating cooling system for the equipment and the domestic water consumption by our staffs. Recirculating cooling water, mainly the equipment cooling water, is pumped into the production water supply pipeline for reuse after cooling in a cooling tower. The domestic water consumption (mainly washing water, flushing water for offices, and recirculating cooling water within the plants) is recycled and not discharged. The environmental hygiene department regularly collects the domestic wastewater for centralised treatment at sewage treatment plants.
